#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);
    std::vector<char> result;
    bool flag_at = true;
    int len = s.length();

    for (int index = 0; index < len; ++index) {
        char ch = s[index];

        if (index >= 2 && index < len - 1) {
            if (s.substr(index - 2, 3) == "dot") {
                result.pop_back();
                result.pop_back();
                result.push_back('.');
                continue;
            }
        }

        if (index >= 1 && index < len - 1) {
            if (s.substr(index - 1, 2) == "at" && flag_at) {
                result.pop_back();
                result.push_back('@');
                flag_at = false;
                continue;
            }
        }

        result.push_back(ch);
    }

    for (char c : result) {
        std::cout << c;
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
